title: Clearer Communications for Alleged Sexual Misconduct Incidents at Autonomous Universities
what_it_is: Clearer Communications for Alleged Sexual Misconduct Incidents at Autonomous Universities

sections.label: NUS staff dismissal case
sections.summary: A former NUS teaching staff was dismissed for an intimate relationship with an undergraduate, and a Police report was made over sexual misconduct allegations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The question raised by Mr Lim Biow Chuan follows the recent media coverage of the case involving a former teaching staff at the National University of Singapore or NUS who was dismissed for being in an intimate relationship with an undergraduate, which is a clear contravention of NUS' Code of Conduct for staff.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Given the undergraduate's allegations of sexual misconduct against the individual, a Police report was made and the investigation is underway.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Where allegations of serious misconduct are made, the Institutes of Higher Learning, or IHLs, will immediately require the accused individual to stay away from campus temporarily, if they assess that the alleged offender may pose a danger to any member of their community.

sections.label: Student sexual misconduct disciplinary cases
sections.summary: The AUs handled 56 disciplinary cases involving sexual misconduct committed by students from 2015 to 2017.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the second question that the Member raised, on the number of incidents, the AUs handled a total of 56 disciplinary cases involving sexual misconduct committed by students from 2015 to 2017.

sections.label: Victim Care Units
sections.summary: The Victim Care Units are staffed by professionally trained care officers to provide first line care and support to victims of sexual misconduct.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The Victim Care Units, or VCUs, are staffed by professionally trained care officers and their objective is to provide the first line of care and support to victims of sexual misconduct.

sections.label: Two investigation tracks
sections.summary: There are two tracks of investigations when an offence around sexual misconduct is highlighted in the IHLs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the first, I would like to share that there are two tracks of investigations when an offence around sexual misconduct is highlighted in the IHLs.

sections.label: Police investigation track
sections.summary: When there are concerns of a serious offence, a Police report is made and the Police carry out an independent track of investigations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: When there are concerns of a serious offence having occurred, a Police report is made and investigations are carried out by the Police.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, there is an independent track of investigations.
